text: A month into daily use, the biggest surprise is how little the Aurora X2 has failed me for $149. I care about ANC. And it works. My bus ride was silent. But the cushions, not really great after two hours? My ears got tired. So now I take them off, shake them like the old headphones. The battery goes like 30hrs, and the sound really pops - really loud, really clear... So you get a lot out of this, if you want it. I recommend it to anybody just wanting an everyday headphone for reasonable money.
